task: Implement the SAA 2025 Login screen (/login) per MoMorph GzbNeVGJHz with Supabase (local) Google OAuth, VN/EN language switch, and a minimal protected /todo page
acceptanceCriteria: /login renders header (logo left, VN language selector right, fixed), hero key visual, ROOT FURTHER title, intro texts, LOGIN With Google button, fixed footer — matching the MoMorph design
Language selector defaults to VN with flag + chevron; click opens VN/EN menu; choosing EN sets NEXT_LOCALE cookie and re-renders all login text in English
Clicking LOGIN With Google disables the button, shows a loader, and same-tab redirects to Supabase /auth/v1/authorize with provider=google and redirect_to /auth/callback
/auth/callback exchanges the PKCE code and redirects to /todo on success; failure or cancel redirects to /login?error=... and the inline error 'Đăng nhập không thành công. Vui lòng thử lại.' is shown
Unauthenticated access to /todo redirects to /login; authenticated access to /login redirects to /todo
/todo shows the signed-in user's email and a Logout button; logout returns to /login
Login button shows shadow/elevation on hover; language selector shows pointer + highlight on hover
supabase/ config (config.toml with Google provider via env) and .env.example committed; no secrets committed
blastRadius: all routes via proxy (session refresh + redirects)
